unknowns: Synthetic adverse cases exercise the candidate rules only. They are not a recorded vendor capture and do not qualify any feed.
The public page dated 2024-06-06 and reviewed 2025-04-08 describes unauthenticated submissions JSON and does not pin acceptanceDateTime as a frozen schema.
SEC programmatic access requires a declared user-agent. This packet does not send one.
Real-time submissions versus the nightly bulk ZIP were not compared.
Company facts are an aggregate across submissions. Amendment visibility lag is unmeasured. They are not the as-of source.
Frames return the last filed fact that best fits a calendar period. That is a current view, not a decision-time view.
Demo REST base https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 was observed 2026-10-17. trade-api/v2 is not a selected API version.
Demo credentials are not shared with production and are not authorized by this packet.
Historical cutoff timestamps move. A replay must record the cutoff it saw. That experiment was not run.
Multivariate markets use a separate channel and are outside this fixture.
The fetched lifecycle page lists REST statuses initialized, active, inactive, closed, determined, disputed, amended, and finalized. It does not list void.
app/ingest/edgar_pipeline.py reads acceptanceDateTime and rejects rows that are not unambiguous newest-first. It does not retain an out-of-order acceptance as a later knowledge version.
app/filings/raw_store.py is vendored write-once accession bytes. This packet does not restructure it and does not treat it as an event-market store.
app/storage/parquet_store.py is write-once and keyed by date and symbol. It has no event-market identity or correction lineage.
app/quant/feed/replay.py orders book and trade rows by recv_ts. It does not carry filing corrections, corporate actions, or event resolution.
app/ingest/dedup.py is an in-memory LRU on source and article id. Eviction can forget a key. It is not content-hash identity and it is not durable.
Current news connectors are stock-centric and outside this envelope. License, spend, and retention are unresolved.
